# MAC scheduler simulation — results (generated by tools/mac-sim/macsim.py)

SIMULATION. Reproduce: `python3 tools/mac-sim/macsim.py --seeds 10 --duration 5.5 --warmup 0.5`

All values: mean ± 95 % confidence half-width over 10 seeds; 5.5 s per run (0.5 s warm-up excluded). SIMULATION, not the testbed.

### Paired differences (A minus B, per seed; mean ± 95 % CI)

The same seed gives every scheduler the same UE drop, fading and packets, so a per-seed difference whose interval excludes 0 is a real effect of the scheduler in this model.
